label_definition.1: Sentence describes collection, use, sharing, retention, tracking, or another concrete handling of personal/user/device data (ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md).
label_definition.0: Sentence does not describe a data practice (ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md).

annotation_provenance: Annotator A = Claude (AI assistant), applying ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md. Labels were fixed BEFORE any prefilter prediction was generated and have not been changed since. This is NOT a human-annotated set and no second annotator exists yet; a human review pass is recommended before citing it as human ground truth.
notes: Independent of the 14-example dev set (ground_truth.json) and of the prefilter training fixture; leakage and near-duplicate checks are run by scripts/run_classification_evaluation.py.
